unit.description: Every program `make test` runs (one testcase each) plus the docs/theory contract check.

trace.description: Only the unit testcases named with a [REQ-...] marker.

perf.description: Existing `make bench`: the 18 s route against docs/run.csv. One testcase; no timing threshold.

e2e.description: Existing `make smoke` (Emscripten build + Playwright, PC and iPhone-sized views). One testcase.

integration.reason: No layer between the C programs and the browser smoke; the smoke already drives the built WASM end to end.

visual.reason: The smoke takes screenshots but compares no pixels; no visual baseline exists.

mem.reason: No sanitizer build in this repo; memory checks run from the central M65 adapter (testing/adapters/nonfunctional.mk).

quality.reason: Coverage/mutation are M66 and not adopted here.
